scope: Independent geometric necessity screening; no donor-static height or pitch target in any reachability test. No force fitting or dynamics integration. New Claude contents excluded.

biological_pose.contract: Every one of 436 original AB07 static rows, full 21 coordinates; radians conversion once. All biological q held exactly fixed, no fit/assemble/default filling/clamp. No static clock filtering/interpolation.

surfaces_and_planes.surface: Minimum Y of fixed unscaled left foot STL vertices
surfaces_and_planes.role: Encoded measured-COP plane convention; physical floor not independently identified
Geometric comparison to force-law plane; STL is not contact sphere geometry
Geometric comparison to detector plane; STL is not detector points

surfaces_and_planes.surface: Minimum sphere-center Y minus its corresponding radius, left eight frozen force-contact spheres
surfaces_and_planes.role: Operational force-law geometric zero-depth boundary, no force computed

surfaces_and_planes.surface: Minimum Y of the two frozen detector points
surfaces_and_planes.role: Operational binary geometric boundary, no detector runtime or event inferred

modes.variables: No q changes, biological/raw knee/raw ankle retained
modes.purpose: Signed plane clearances, not a forced root or assurance contact requires exact zero

modes.variables: Only pros_ankle_angle free over exact XML range; pros_knee_angle raw retained
modes.root_rule: Bracket sign changes plus exact endpoint zeros and Brent root xtol1e-12 rad; choose found root nearest raw ankle; no global/tangential-root completeness claim

modes.variables: pros_knee_angle sampled over exact XML range every5deg plus each raw knee and raw0; ankle as previous mode
modes.selection: Root witness minimizes found squared angular distance from raw knee+ankle; minimum is among declared knee-grid candidates, not a global optimum or clinical plausibility criterion

continuous_bounds: Global min/max grid clearances are supplied with explicit Lipschitz bounds in m. A found root proves geometric existence. No root on a finite grid is not alone proof of impossibility. Only a strict positive/negative bound across the continuous declared domain may certify unreachability; otherwise unresolved.

range_contract.witness_metadata: Report actual angles, deviations from raw knee/ankle, residual m and distances to bounds; no unsupported clinical acceptance judgement

geometry_contract: Exact left-chain joint topology/axes/functions and zero frames are checked from XML before algebra. L0/L1 physical chain differs only ankle-parent mountY; marker offsets may differ and are not used in reachability.

Fixed foot hardware STL and all contact/detector points are byte-frozen. Convex-hull vertex reduction preserves minima of any linear projection; parity is checked against all STL vertices on declared test orientations.
Native Position FK parity on sparse original and witness poses; no native solver/assembly/clamping. Coordinate and center/surface parity tolerances1e-12 m/rad stated separately.
physical_identification: Report pin-to-surface dimensions and healthy own hip/knee/ankle centers as model geometry. Generic healthy visual meshes and force-contact spheres are not acquisition-specific shoe/physical sole measurements.

Neither freely calibrated virtual marker positions nor absence/presence of contact proves physical subject-specific pylon length. Static GRF/platform calibration/hardware fiducials/clinical fitting dimensions are absent from inspected artifacts.
Reaching a plane within broad knee/ankle model ranges differs from reaching with the original tracked q; the latter is reported without changing raw q. No donor pitch target is imposed.
Actual dynamic screening at14 cases belongs to root; it cannot redefine geometric length by forcing GRF agreement.
